text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, when I went to the trainer's office,
Fuji Kiseki was reading fan letters.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see... It really is great to receive
words from the fans in a visible way
like this, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "The person who sent this letter is... ah, the one who always gives me bouquets at races."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
This letter here is... from someone who
always passionately follows me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"Let's see... 'I was seated on the left side
for this concert, but I felt like you didn't look
my way very much,' huh."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Hmm, maybe I focused too much on the performance itself and didn't appeal enough to the crowd."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Old theatrical habits die hard, it seems...
I feel terrible for doing that to her.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Of course.
I want to deliver joy to all our fans, after all.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: If all you want is to be drunk on yourself, leaving things half-finished is fine. But that's not the kind of entertainment I'm aiming for.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Now then, gotta write a reply.
What should I write~♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With that, Fuji Kiseki happily gazed down at the letter.
